datasets.label: PopinSnake upstream three-sample example dataset
datasets.description: The example input distributed with the pinned PopinSnake source revision: S0001, S0002, and S0003 BAM/BAI pairs plus the chromosome 21 insertion reference. The missing FASTA index was derived inside the private run with Samtools 1.15.1 and all exact inputs were checksummed before execution.
datasets.storage_location: User-controlled FONDA PVC in the run operator's Kubernetes namespace; exact paths remain in the private metrics audit.
datasets.access_statement: The tested copy and checksum manifest remain with the run on the private PVC. The upstream example data are available from the pinned public repository revision.
